source.title: Monthly overseas travel and tourism reference tables, January to June 2024, provisional monthly estimates (released 18 October 2024), Table 1: overseas residents' visits by month and area of residence

notes: The latest 24 months the ONS has published as monthly figures: July 2022 to June 2024. The ONS publishes no later month: from July 2024 the International Passenger Survey runs on a new design published by quarter only (its 2025 quarters were released 16 October 2026), and the ONS says the old and new designs are not to be compared.

Two releases: July 2022 to December 2023 are final UK estimates (released 17 May 2024); January to June 2024 are provisional Great Britain estimates (released 18 October 2024). The October 2024 workbook removed the 2019 to 2023 months while the ONS reviews their quality; the May 2024 workbook is still on the ONS site as a previous version of the same dataset.
Every value: Table 1, World Total, rounded by the ONS to the nearest 1,000. Raw files and their URLs: data/raw/uk5-visitors/SOURCES.md.
